summary: Profile regression fix: closed areas formed by vertical faces are enveloped directly again, nested compounds are flattened via a new internal Path.Geom.uncompound() helper (also used by DressupPathBoundary), and combineConnectedShapes/combineHorizontalFaces gain a BoundBox pre-check; no property, default, enumeration, panel control or output semantics change.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Profile.py: _processBase now builds an envelope from combineConnectedShapes(vertFaces) and only falls back to bottom edges when that fails; this restores the documented behaviour for vertical faces forming a closed area. Remaining hunks (uncompound in _processEachModel, base-less _processHorFace, closed/open wire split, tolerance fallback, removed unused offset) are internal; no areaOpProperties, PROP_DFLTS or enumeration hunks.
Path/Dressup/Boundary.py execute(): stock SubShapes replaced by Path.Geom.uncompound(obj.Stock.Shape), a bug fix for nested compound stock with identical offset output; no property or option change.

Candidate dropped as mis-mapped: Path/Geom.py is a geometry helper module, not the Area feature. Hunks add uncompound(), add BoundBox.intersect pre-checks in combineConnectedShapes/combineHorizontalFaces and comment out a debug call; all internal.
